title: Separated finite-presentation diagonal of the stack of polarized proper schemes

standard_prerequisites.use: Proper flat finitely presented families, relatively ample line bundles, representability of Hom/Isom and polarized moduli, cohomology/base change for large tensor powers, projective embeddings and limit criteria for finite presentation.

core_obligations: Translate the diagonal into isomorphisms of two polarized proper families and use the ample embeddings to impose a common finite presentation.
Control the relevant isomorphism locus and polarization-identification data so the diagonal is quasi-compact as well as locally finitely presented and separated.

proof_roadmap.step: Translate the diagonal into isomorphisms of two polarized proper families and use the ample embeddings to impose a common finite presentation.
Control the relevant isomorphism locus and polarization-identification data so the diagonal is quasi-compact as well as locally finitely presented and separated.

difficulty_reason: The finite-presentation conclusion requires a uniform bound on the polarization data, not merely the existence of an Isom algebraic space. The source carries out this boundedness and separation argument, giving H2 work after the representability foundations.

compared.difference: This migrates the existing unpublished research record, not an additional count beside it.
